75683-the-telephone-the-microphone-the-p.title: The Microphone & The Phonograph
75683-the-telephone-the-microphone-the-p.creator: Count Du Moncel
75683-the-telephone-the-microphone-the-p.description: A book by Count Du Moncel. Strictly speaking, the telephone is merely an instrument adapted for the transmission of sound to a distance, and this idea of transmitting sound is as old as the world itself. The Greeks made use of means which might effect it, and there is no doubt that these means were sometimes used for the pagan oracles.

arxiv-2208-07502.title: Combinatorial optimization solving by coherent Ising machines based on spiking neural networks
arxiv-2208-07502.creator: Bo Lu, Yong-Pan Gao, Kai Wen, Chuan Wang
arxiv-2208-07502.description: Abstract Spiking neural network is a kind of neuromorphic computing that is believed to improve the level of intelligence and provide advantages for quantum computing. In this work, we address this issue by designing an optical spiking neural network and find that it can be used to accelerate the speed of computation, especially on combinatorial optimization problems.

arxiv-2306-05060.title: Precision-aware Latency and Energy Balancing on Multi-Accelerator Platforms for DNN Inference
arxiv-2306-05060.creator: Matteo Risso 1 , Alessio Burrello 1 2 , Giuseppe Maria Sarda 3 , Luca Benini 2 , Enrico Macii 1 , Massimo Poncino 1 , Marian Verhelst 3 , Daniele Jahier Pagliari 1
arxiv-2306-05060.description: Abstract The need to execute Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) at low latency and low power at the edge has spurred the development of new heterogeneous Systems-on-Chips (SoCs) encapsulating a diverse set of hardware accelerators. How to optimally map a DNN onto such multi-accelerator systems is an open problem.

arxiv-2407-06269.title: Intertwined formation of H 2 \rm{H_{2}} , dust, and stars in cosmological simulations
arxiv-2407-06269.creator: Cinthia Ragone-Figueroa, Gian Luigi Granato, Massimiliano Parente, Giuseppe Murante, Milena Valentini, Stefano Borgani, Umberto Maio
arxiv-2407-06269.description: Abstract Context. Molecular hydrogen ( H 2 \rm{H_{2}} ) plays a crucial role in the formation and evolution of galaxies, serving as the primary fuel reservoir for star formation. In a metal-enriched Universe, H 2 \rm{H_{2}} forms mostly through catalysis on interstellar dust grain surfaces.

arxiv-2407-07037.title: Molecular Nanomagnet Cu II ​ Ni II ​ Cu II \text{Cu}^{\text{II}}\text{Ni}^{\text{II}}\text{Cu}^{\text{II}} as Resource for Bipartite and Tripartite Quantum Entanglement and Coherence
arxiv-2407-07037.creator: Azadeh Ghannadan, Hamid Arian Zad, Saeed Haddadi, Jozef Strečka, Zhirayr Adamyan, Vadim Ohanyan
arxiv-2407-07037.description: Abstract We investigate key quantum characteristics of the mixed spin-(1/2,1,1/2) Heisenberg trimer under the influence of an external magnetic field. Specifically, we analyze the distributions of bipartite and tripartite entanglement quantified through the respective negativities, and the l 1 l_{1} -norm of coherence with the help of rigorous analytical and numerical methods.

arxiv-2501-04888.title: Beyond Integral-Domain Stabilizer Codes
arxiv-2501-04888.creator: Lane G. Gunderman
arxiv-2501-04888.description: Abstract Quantum error-correcting codes aim to protect information in quantum systems to enable fault-tolerant quantum computations. The most prevalent method, stabilizer codes, has been well developed for many varieties of systems, however, largely the case of composite number of levels in the system has been avoided.

arxiv-2512-00556.title: Bias Testing and Mitigation in Black Box LLMs using Metamorphic Relations DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology; ; CCS: Software and its engineering CCS: Computing methodologies Machine learning algorithms
arxiv-2512-00556.creator: Sina Salimian, Gias Uddin, Sumon Biswas, Henry Leung
arxiv-2512-00556.description: Abstract . The widespread deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) has intensified concerns about subtle social biases embedded in their outputs. Existing guardrails often fail when faced with indirect or contextually complex bias-inducing prompts. To address these limitations, we propose a unified framework for both systematic bias evaluation and targeted mitigation.

Using gene targeting, we demonstrate that the hematopoietic specific, actin- and Arp2/3 complex-binding prote

pmc-10507033.title: Bisphosphonate conjugation enhances the bone-specificity of NELL-1-based systemic therapy for spaceflight-induced bone loss in mice
pmc-10507033.creator: Pin Ha, Jin Hee Kwak, Yulong Zhang, Jiayu Shi, Luan Tran, Timothy Pan Liu, Hsin-Chuan Pan, Samantha Lee, Jong Kil Kim, Eric Chen, Yasaman Shirazi-Fard, Louis S. Stodieck, Andy Lin, Zhong Zheng, Stella Nuo Dong, Xinli Zhang, Benjamin M. Wu, Kang Ting, Chia Soo
pmc-10507033.description: Microgravity-induced bone loss results in a 1% bone mineral density loss monthly and can be a mission critical factor in long-duration spaceflight. Biomolecular therapies with dual osteogenic and anti-resorptive functions are promising for treating extreme osteoporosis. We previously confirmed that NELL-like molecule-1 (NELL-1) is crucial for bone density maintenance.

pmc-11434954.title: Exploring the Effect of an Obesity-Prevention Intervention on Various Child Subgroups: A Post Hoc Subgroup Analysis of the Kiel Obesity Prevention Study
pmc-11434954.creator: Elizabeth Mannion, Kristine Bihrmann, Sandra Plachta-Danielzik, Manfred J Müller, Anja Bosy-Westphal, Christian Ritz
pmc-11434954.description: Background: This study investigated potential subgroups of children within the Kiel Obesity Prevention Study (KOPS) for differing treatment effects for the outcome measures of overweight or obesity at 4 years. The KOPS study delivered a multicomponent school intervention to cohorts of children in Kiel but found no overall effect on the weight status outcome.

pmc-12355845.title: Efficacy and safety of CT-guided 125I particle implantation for the treatment of elderly lung cancer: a system evaluation and meta-analysis
pmc-12355845.creator: Qiuping Li, Yingrui Huang, Chuncheng Shen, Jiatong Zhou, Ping Lin, Yanfei Lu, Anxin He, Xiang Liu, Miao Luo
pmc-12355845.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundTo systematically evaluate the efficacy and safety of 125I particle implantation in the treatment of elderly lung cancer.MethodsBoth randomized and non-randomized controlled studies on CT-guided 125I particle implantation therapy for the treatment of elderly lung cancer patients were retrieved from databases including PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library, China National Knowledge Infrastructure, Wanfang Data, VIP, and SinoMed from inception to October 31, 2022. Two researchers screened the retrieved studies, extracted data, and evaluated the study quality independently.

pmc-12489294.title: Mapping the transcriptional landscape of algal resistance to viral infection reveals a core expression program
pmc-12489294.creator: Talia S. Shaler, Amir Fromm, Daniella Schatz, Shifra Ben‐Dor, Ester Feldmesser, Assaf Vardi
pmc-12489294.description: Summary Algal blooms and their demise by viruses drive global‐scale ecological processes in the ocean. These blooms form the foundation of marine food webs, regulate microbial communities, and shape biogeochemical cycles. Although algal populations are constantly infected by viruses, resistant subpopulations frequently emerge after the infection. Yet, antiviral molecular mechanisms of marine microalgae are underexplored.

pmc-12588584.title: Speckle Tracking Echocardiography in Pediatric and Congenital Heart Disease Patients with the Micra™ Leadless Pacemaker
pmc-12588584.creator: Natalia Betancourt-Guzman, Jeremy Markowitz, Erick Jimenez, Daniel Cortez, Brenda Dugas, Daniel Peck, Matthew Ambrose, Bradley C Clark
pmc-12588584.description: Right ventricular pacing can cause electrical and mechanical dyssynchrony, potentially leading to pacemaker-induced cardiomyopathy (PICM). This pilot study evaluates speckle tracking echocardiography for the early detection of subclinical left ventricular dysfunction in pediatric and congenital heart disease patients with Micra™ leadless pacemakers (Medtronic, Minneapolis, MN, USA).

pmc-12589532.title: Computational and molecular docking analysis of a novel azo compound and its nanocomposite biopolymer synthesized via a single-pot method
pmc-12589532.creator: Manar Ghyath Abd-Almutalib, N A Naser
pmc-12589532.description: The synthesis of an azo molecule from phenol and dapsone was investigated using density functional theory (DFT) and infrared spectroscopy. The electronic structure and molecular interactions of the 4-((4-((4-aminophenyl)sulfonyl)phenyl)diazenyl) phenol (AZO) compound were analyzed at the B3LYP/6-311G(d,p) level. Pharmacokinetic properties were predicted using Swiss ADME, and molecular docking revealed π-alkyl and hydrophobic interactions with the 3H7O protein.

pmc-12717960.title: Mycobacterium arosiense Infection in a Patient with CD209 Mutation: A Rare Case Report
pmc-12717960.creator: Junwei Su, Kou Ni, Yueting Du, Wei Yu, Kaijin Xu, Jifang Sheng
pmc-12717960.description: We report a case of an adult male with a history of recurrent cough and chest pain for five years. Mycobacterium arosiense was identified in his alveolar lavage fluid, and whole-exome sequencing revealed heterozygosity for CD209 in this patient. After 17 months of combined antibiotic therapy, the patient recovered completely.

pmc-13282933.title: Massive Hemoptysis Revealing Rasmussen’s Aneurysm in Active Pulmonary Tuberculosis: A Report of a Fatal Case
pmc-13282933.creator: Mohammed Aharmim, Mohamed Lakhal, Nezha Reguig, Jamal Eddine El bourkadi
pmc-13282933.description: Rasmussen’s aneurysm is a rare but potentially fatal vascular complication of pulmonary tuberculosis and an uncommon cause of massive hemoptysis. A 27-year-old female with no significant past medical history was admitted for a seven-month history of productive cough, intermittent mild hemoptysis, fever, night sweats, and marked asthenia.

pmc-13654893.title: Transcranial ultrasonography via sonolucent implants: a review
pmc-13654893.creator: Marcio Yuri Ferreira, Alleh Nogueira, Artur Shlifer, Vadim Zhigin, Faith Singh, Tamika Wong, Olivia Albers, Sana Bokil, Brianna Suffren, Raphael Bertani, David Langer, Netanel Ben-Shalom
pmc-13654893.description: Transcranial ultrasound (TCUS) imaging techniques via sonolucent implants have demonstrated clinical utility across a variety of settings and are increasingly being adopted in neurosurgical and neurocritical care practices worldwide. This review appraises the use of ultrasound through sonolucent implants in clinical contexts, providing a critical evaluation of its diagnostic, prognostic, and therapeutic potential.

uslaw-usc-t49-s32508.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t49-s32508.description: United States Code, Title 49 (Transportation); Part C (Information, Standards, And Requirements); Chapter 325 (Bumper Standards). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. When an owner of a passenger motor vehicle sustains damages as a result of a motor vehicle accident because the vehicle did not comply with a standard prescribed under section 32502 of this title, the owner may bring a civil action.
